description: This file defines an interface 'RequestExceptionInterface' related to HTTP client request errors, inheriting from ClientExceptionInterface. It declares a method to retrieve the associated HTTP request.

classes.name: RequestExceptionInterface
classes.description: Interface for exceptions occurring during HTTP requests, providing a method to retrieve the associated request object.

methods.name: getRequest
methods.description: Returns the HTTP request associated with the exception, which may differ from the original request object passed to the client.
